newsitem.title: DENMARK: Berendsen share dips on Rentokil. [corrected 10:06 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Berendsen share dips on Rentokil. [corrected 10:06 gmt]

text.p: Shares in Danish holding company Sophus Berendsen dipped three percent on Wednesday on a lower than expected 1996 result for its 36 percent-owned British unit Rentokil.
"The result simply failed to live up to expectations and growth forecasts have been reduced," one dealer said.

Pest control and environmental services firm Rentokil earlier posted pre-tax profits of 318 (corrects from 308) million sterling for 1996, down on market expectations of a 317-335 million sterling surplus.
The Berendsen share traded 27 crowns lower at 850 crowns at 0915 gmt, after initially falling 30 crowns to 847. --Chris Follett, Coppenhagen newsroom
